dataset.name: HoloAssist
dataset.license_or_access_note: Official HoloAssist compressed video release under CDLA-Permissive-2.0: https://cdla.dev/permissive-2-0/.

source_acquisition.verification: Declared first-party range matches the local full source member byte length.

observed_events.description: The wearer handles a red-tethered handheld grip and brings its connector next to the same GoPro; the camera is not fastened to it in this released portion.
The wearer leaves the grip aside, takes a Rollei elastic head strap, and aligns, inserts and turns the thumb screw to mount the same GoPro to the head strap.

supported_claims.text: The red-tethered handheld camera grip is the initially handled mount, but the camera is not yet attached.
The wearer sets up an elastic head strap and fastens the same action camera to its plate.

screening.proposed_instruction: Could you save a video showing how to attach this camera to the mount I’m setting up and get it ready to film?
screening.source_continuity: Continuous [230.2, 316.2] seconds from one original recording.

construct.research_question: Can an agent replace a tutorial tied to an initially attempted mount when the actual setup uses another mounting form?
construct.belief_before: A handheld action-camera grip is selected and trial-positioned; a tutorial for attaching to such a grip is a reasonable provisional match.
construct.belief_after: The same camera is set up on an elastic head strap instead of the grip.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep one video that actually shows attachment and preparation on a compatible elastic head strap. Replace a grip-only tutorial if previously saved.
construct.no_update_failure: Keep a handheld-grip-only tutorial, a comparison that omits attachment, or a tutorial for a different body mount.
construct.overupdate_failure: Keep both an old grip-only guide and a head-strap guide when the user asked to save one video.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The request names no device brand or mount type. Only the continuous view shows which mounting form is selected and used for this setup.

task_blueprint.instruction: Could you save a video showing how to attach this camera to the mount I’m setting up and get it ready to film?

observed.why: The red-tethered hand grip is being selected and positioned for this setup before a mounting method is settled.
The hand grip is set aside and a distinct elastic head strap is selected for the same camera; the rest of the released session shows the head-strap connection.

catalog_resolution.answer_boundary_rule: Save one tutorial that demonstrates attaching or configuring a compatible action camera on an elastic head strap and preparing it to film. Other strap placements, already mounted sample footage, or a generic screw demonstration without the head-strap setup do not suffice. A real tutorial that teaches both provisional grip and final head-strap setups is acceptable at both stages.
